purpose: Record representative correct, rejected, and false-positive behaviors observed through the actual browser ONNX pipeline. No source images are copied into this report.
externalDataset: Grape Leaf Health Mendeley V1, DOI 10.17632/378c69nwk5.1, CC BY 4.0

examples.appDisplayedLabel: النمط البصري أقرب إلى فئة Esca (لا يؤكد المرض)
examples.interpretation: Representative positive example from the GVLiD held-out test split; this is an India-source image, not a Syrian field validation example.

examples.appDisplayedLabel: لم يرصد النموذج نمطاً واضحاً متوافقاً مع Esca
examples.interpretation: Correctly avoided an Esca-like alert on this healthy reference image. This does not prove the vine is free of other diseases.

examples.appDisplayedLabel: النمط البصري أقرب إلى فئة Esca (لا يؤكد المرض)
examples.interpretation: False Esca-like alert on a different disease. This is a real open-set failure and is why the UI must show the narrow-class warning and must not recommend treatment.
The app rejected the score because it was below the 0.85 gate rather than forcing a class.

note: Examples are from an external non-Syrian dataset and do not establish field accuracy.
